items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Unless somebody was a piano player like Drew Robson or someone would stop in, you know.

ctx.x: $60 a week was good money then. Yeah. Oh yeah. In the forties. What did you have a long lunch hour on a job like that? Yeah, an hour. I'd give him an hour. Well who would play guitar when you were out?

They didn't use the guitar. Oh I see. Octave played the piano. I see. And when, when Octave go, I just play the guitar until he come back, you see. Unless somebody was a piano player like Drew Robson or someone would stop in, you know.
